title: Hearing on social media, screen time and youth mental health
summary: The Council's Children & Youth, Mental Health & Substance Use, and Oversight & Investigations Committees held a joint hearing on how social media and screen time affect young people's mental health. Lawmakers examined related bills that would restrict youth social media use, require city reporting on social media's mental health effects, and study links between online activity and in-person youth altercations. The hearing drew on city health data showing rising anxiety and depression among teens who use social media, and reviewed city programs such as NYC TeenSpace and school-based mental health clinics.
